mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5pp over 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and compress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth slows by > 100k jobs/mo for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth slows by > 100k jobs/mo for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decline by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market and reduced residential investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST declines > 10% y/y.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth accelerates by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a strengthening manufacturing sector and potential economic overheating, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO growth accelerates by > 1% m/m.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a potential inflationary spiral that will erode the purchasing power of future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending (RSAFS) declines by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate is rising, it signals a potential consumer-led recession that will depress corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines > 1% m/m and UNRATE rising
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines > 1% m/m and UNRATE is rising.
